statute_evaluations.name: Punishment for cheating.

ingredient_analysis.text: Whoever cheats
ingredient_analysis.evidence: The complainant alleged that the accused Ram cheated him of Rs 50,000 by making false promises about a job. Ram intentionally tricked the complainant and ran away with the money. (signal: deception_for_gain)

statute_evaluations.overall_reasoning: The case facts explicitly state that the accused cheated the complainant, directly satisfying the core ingredient of this section.

statute_evaluations.name: Cheating with knowledge that wrongful loss may ensue to person whose interest offender is bound to protect.

ingredient_analysis.text: Whoever cheats
ingredient_analysis.evidence: The complainant alleged that the accused Ram cheated him of Rs 50,000 by making false promises about a job. Ram intentionally tricked the complainant and ran away with the money.

ingredient_analysis.text: with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause wrongful loss
ingredient_analysis.evidence: Ram intentionally tricked the complainant and ran away with the money, implying knowledge of causing wrongful loss.

ingredient_analysis.text: to a person whose interest in the transaction to which the cheating relates
ingredient_analysis.evidence: The complainant was the person whose interest in the transaction (getting a job for money) was affected by the cheating.

ingredient_analysis.text: he was bound, either by law, or by a legal contract, to protect
ingredient_analysis.evidence: No evidence in the case facts that Ram was bound by law or legal contract to protect the complainant's interest.

statute_evaluations.overall_reasoning: While cheating and knowledge of wrongful loss are present, there is no evidence that the accused was bound to protect the complainant's interests.

statute_evaluations.name: Cheating.

ingredient_analysis.text: Whoever, by deceiving any person
fraudulently or dishonestly induces the person so deceived to deliver any property to any person, or to consent that any person shall retain any property

intentionally induces the person so deceived to do or omit to do anything which he would not do or omit if he were not so deceived, and which act or omission causes or is likely to cause damage or harm to that person in body, mind, reputation or property
A dishonest concealment of facts is a deception within the meaning of this section.

statute_evaluations.name: Dishonest or fraudulent removal or concealment of property.

ingredient_analysis.text: A person dishonestly or fraudulently conceals any property of himself or any other person.
A person dishonestly or fraudulently removes any property of himself or any other person.
A person dishonestly or fraudulently assists in the concealment of property.
A person dishonestly or fraudulently assists in the removal of property.
A person dishonestly releases any demand or claim to which he is entitled.

statute_evaluations.name: Fraudulently obtaining decree for sum not due.

ingredient_analysis.text: Whoever fraudulently obtains a decree or order against any person for a sum not due
Whoever fraudulently obtains a decree or order against any person for a larger sum than is due
Whoever fraudulently obtains a decree or order against any person for any property or interest in property to which he is not entitled
Whoever fraudulently causes a decree or order to be executed against any person after it has been satisfied
Whoever fraudulently causes a decree or order to be executed against any person for anything in respect of which it has been satisfied
Whoever fraudulently suffers or permits any such act to be done in his name

statute_evaluations.name: Fraudulent use of false weight or measure.

statute_evaluations.name: Dishonest or fraudulent removal or concealment of property to prevent distribution among creditor.

ingredient_analysis.text: A person dishonestly or fraudulently removes any property.
A person dishonestly or fraudulently conceals any property.
A person dishonestly or fraudulently delivers any property to any person.
A person dishonestly or fraudulently transfers any property to any person without adequate consideration.
A person dishonestly or fraudulently causes any property to be transferred to any person without adequate consideration.
The person intends to prevent the distribution of that property according to law among his creditors or the creditors of any other person.
The person knows it is likely that the action will thereby prevent the distribution of that property according to law among his creditors or the creditors of any other person.

statute_evaluations.name: Dishonest or fraudulent execution of deed of transfer containing false statement of consideration.

ingredient_analysis.text: The accused dishonestly or fraudulently signs, executes or becomes a party to any deed or instrument.

The deed or instrument contains any false statement relating to the person or persons for whose use or benefit it is really intended to operate.

statute_evaluations.name: Falsification of accounts.

which belongs to or is in the possession of his employer, or has been received by him for or on behalf of his employer

makes or abets the making of any false entry in, or omits or alters or abets the omission or alteration of any material particular from or in. any such book, electronic record, paper, writing, valuable security or account

statute_evaluations.name: Dishonest misappropriation of property.

ingredient_analysis.text: Whoever dishonestly misappropriates any movable property.
Whoever dishonestly converts to his own use any movable property.
A dishonest misappropriation for a time only is a misappropriation.
A person finds property not in the possession of any other person.
The finder takes such property for the purpose of protecting it for, or of restoring it to, the owner, and does not take or misappropriate it dishonestly.
The finder appropriates the found property to his own use.
At the time of appropriation, the finder has not kept the property a reasonable time to enable the owner to claim it.
At the time of appropriating found property, the finder does not believe it to be his own property.
At the time of appropriating found property, the finder does not in good faith believe that the real owner cannot be found.

statute_evaluations.name: Dishonest misappropriation of property possessed by deceased person at the time of his death.

ingredient_analysis.text: Whoever dishonestly misappropriates or converts to his own use property

and has not since been in the possession of any person legally entitled to such possession
if the offender at the time of such person's decease was employed by him as a clerk or servant
